capabilities: Rebuild the entire File Explorer pane from disk via the command palette
Reload a single folder from its right-click menu
Reload a folder with all of its subfolders
extras: Ships a demo vault with every release (also installable via a command) that documents the feature; beta installs require the BRAT plugin; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin refreshes only the file list: the entire pane, a single folder, or a folder and everything beneath it.
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer pane can go stale when files are copied, moved, or deleted outside the app, and the only built-in fix is a full app reload that discards the session and is slow on large vaults.

relations.evidence: Periodic polling of configured folders; adds new synced files; desktop/mobile
Indexes hidden folders; rebuilds metadata cache; reloads plugins
explorer button renames symlink folders out/back to trigger reread
Periodic whole-vault reconciliation; new/changed files; on-demand scan

summary: File Explorer refresh plugin that reloads the explorer pane, a folder, or a folder with subfolders from disk after files change outside Obsidian.
